notes: PAUSED, BLOCKED and CANCELED require a recorded reason. Resume is explicit reconciliation to the previous active state and requires a resolution; it refuses tasks whose repair budget is still exhausted. Starting RUNNING again after the repair budget is exhausted moves the task and mission to BLOCKED. READY_PR is local evidence only (constitution: Honest records); a failed remote CI result returns READY_PR to IMPLEMENTING, and MERGED requires a successful CI reference for the candidate commit plus an existing merge commit containing it. Local decision references are not authenticated approvals. Delivery states require enabled configuration and external evidence; an unhealthy observation leads to RECOVERING. No deployment command is executed by state transitions.
